row.note: The commentary sends Musa on a road to Midian and then to its water; Exodus 2:15 sends fleeing Moses to Midian, where he sits by a well, supplying the same journey-to-well opening.

row.basis: traveler and camels at a well

row.basis: women draw water at the spring

row.basis: water for a stranger and his animals

row.basis: caravan and the boy in the pit
